import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (is_end : Bool) (children : List (Option Node))
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk b _ => b

def children (t : Node) : List (Option Node) :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk _ c => c

end Node

-- Helper for enum behavior
def enumerate {α} (l : List α) : List (Nat × α) :=
  (List.range l.length).zip l

def join {α} (l : List (List α)) : List α :=
  l.foldr List.append []

def flatMap {α β} (l : List α) (f : α → List β) : List β :=
  join (l.map f)

-- Using Set theory directly
def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let current : Set (List Int) := if t.is_end then {[]} else ∅
  let child_views : Set (List Int) :=
    let indexed_children := enumerate t.children
    indexed_children.foldr (fun (idx_child : Nat × Option Node) acc =>
      match idx_child.2 with
      | some child =>
        let suffix_set := view child
        let prefixed_set := suffix_set.image (fun suffix => (idx_child.1 : Int) :: suffix)
        acc ∪ prefixed_set
      | none => acc
    ) ∅
  current ∪ child_views
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by sorry

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.children.all Option.isNone

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

-- Dafny uses an array of size 256. Here we model it as a list of 256 Option Node.
def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.mk _ children =>
    children.length = 256 ∧
    ∀ c ∈ children, match c with
      | some child => 
          well_formed child ∧ 
          !is_empty_node child -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny's pruning invariant
      | none => True
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by sorry

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
  | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
  | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Added to match Dafny requirement
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def childrenOf (t : Option Node) : List (Option Node) :=
  match t with
  | some n => n.children
  | none => List.replicate 256 none

def isEndOf (t : Option Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | some n => n.is_end
  | none => false

def childAt (cs : List (Option Node)) (i : Nat) : Option Node :=
  match cs[i]? with
  | some c => c
  | none => none

def insertAux (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Node :=
  match key with
  | [] => Node.mk true (childrenOf t)
  | k :: rest =>
    Node.mk (isEndOf t)
      ((childrenOf t).set k.toNat
        (some (insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest)))
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t key) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  insertAux t key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : insert_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  well_formed result ∧
  !is_empty_node result ∧
  view result = view_opt t ∪ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

/-! ### Basic list lemmas -/

lemma my_mem_of_get? {α} : ∀ (l : List α) (i : Nat) (x : α), l[i]? = some x → x ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro i x h; simp at h
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro i x h
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      simp at h
      subst h
      simp
    | succ j =>
      simp at h
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih j x h)

lemma my_exists_get? {α} : ∀ (l : List α) (i : Nat), i < l.length → ∃ x, l[i]? = some x := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro i h; simp at h
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro i h
    cases i with
    | zero => exact ⟨a, by simp⟩
    | succ j =>
      have hj : j < as.length := by simpa using h
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ih j hj
      exact ⟨x, by simpa using hx⟩

lemma my_set_get?_self {α} : ∀ (l : List α) (i : Nat) (a : α), i < l.length →
    (l.set i a)[i]? = some a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro i a h; simp at h
  | cons b bs ih =>
    intro i a h
    cases i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ j =>
      have hj : j < bs.length := by simpa using h
      simpa using ih j a hj

lemma my_set_get?_ne {α} : ∀ (l : List α) (i j : Nat) (a : α), j ≠ i →
    (l.set i a)[j]? = l[j]? := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro i j a h; simp
  | cons b bs ih =>
    intro i j a h
    match i, j with
    | 0, 0 => exact absurd rfl h
    | 0, (j+1) => simp
    | (i+1), 0 => simp
    | (i+1), (j+1) =>
      have h' : j ≠ i := by omega
      simpa using ih i j a h'

lemma my_mem_set_cases {α} : ∀ (l : List α) (i : Nat) (a b : α), b ∈ l.set i a →
    b = a ∨ b ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro i a b h; simp at h
  | cons c cs ih =>
    intro i a b h
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      simp at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (by simp [h])
    | succ j =>
      simp at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact Or.inr (by simp [h])
      · rcases ih j a b h with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inl h'
        · exact Or.inr (by simp [h'])

lemma my_replicate_get?_none {α} (a : α) : ∀ (n i : Nat) (x : α),
    (List.replicate n a)[i]? = some x → x = a := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro i x h; simp at h
  | succ m ih =>
    intro i x h
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      rw [List.replicate_succ] at h
      simp at h
      exact h.symm
    | succ j =>
      rw [List.replicate_succ] at h
      simp at h
      exact ih j x h

lemma my_childAt_get? (cs : List (Option Node)) (i : Nat) (h : i < cs.length) :
    cs[i]? = some (childAt cs i) := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := my_exists_get? cs i h
  have hc : childAt cs i = x := by unfold childAt; rw [hx]
  rw [hc]
  exact hx

/-! ### Unfolding lemmas -/

def Fv : (Nat × Option Node) → Set (List Int) → Set (List Int) :=
  fun p acc =>
    match p.2 with
    | some child => acc ∪ (view child).image (fun suffix => (p.1 : Int) :: suffix)
    | none => acc

lemma view_eq (t : Node) :
    view t = (if t.is_end then ({[]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) ∪
      (enumerate t.children).foldr Fv ∅ := by
  rw [view]
  try rfl

lemma well_formed_mk (b : Bool) (cs : List (Option Node)) :
    well_formed (Node.mk b cs) ↔ (cs.length = 256 ∧
      ∀ c ∈ cs, match c with
        | some child => well_formed child ∧ (!is_empty_node child) = true
        | none => True) := by
  rw [well_formed]
  try rfl

lemma insertAux_nil (t : Option Node) : insertAux t [] = Node.mk true (childrenOf t) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp [insertAux]

lemma insertAux_cons (t : Option Node) (k : Int) (rest : List Int) :
    insertAux t (k :: rest) = Node.mk (isEndOf t)
      ((childrenOf t).set k.toNat
        (some (insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest))) := by
  first
  | rfl
  | simp [insertAux]

/-! ### Membership characterization of `view` -/

lemma mem_enumerate {α} : ∀ (l : List α) (i : Nat) (x : α),
    (i, x) ∈ enumerate l ↔ l[i]? = some x := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro i x; simp [enumerate]
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro i x
    have hE : enumerate (a :: as) = (0, a) :: (enumerate as).map (fun p => (p.1 + 1, p.2)) := by
      unfold enumerate
      rw [List.length_cons, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.zip_cons_cons, List.zip_map_left]
      first
      | rfl
      | (congr 1; funext p; rfl)
      | simp [Prod.map]
    rw [hE]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h1
      · have hi : i = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst h1
        have hx : x = a := congrArg Prod.snd h1
        rw [hi, hx]
        simp
      · obtain ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h1
        obtain ⟨p1, p2⟩ := p
        have hi : p1 + 1 = i := congrArg Prod.fst hpe
        have hx : p2 = x := congrArg Prod.snd hpe
        subst hi
        subst hx
        rw [List.getElem?_cons_succ]
        exact (ih p1 p2).mp hp
    · intro h
      cases i with
      | zero =>
        rw [List.getElem?_cons_zero] at h
        have hax : a = x := Option.some_inj.mp h
        exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl (by rw [hax]))
      | succ j =>
        rw [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at h
        refine List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr ?_)
        exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(j, x), (ih j x).mpr h, rfl⟩

lemma mem_fold : ∀ (ps : List (Nat × Option Node)) (l : List Int),
    l ∈ ps.foldr Fv ∅ ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, ∃ c s, p.2 = some c ∧ l = (p.1 : Int) :: s ∧ s ∈ view c := by
  intro ps
  induction ps with
  | nil => intro l; simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    intro l
    obtain ⟨i, oc⟩ := p
    cases oc with
    | none =>
      have hF : Fv (i, none) (ps.foldr Fv ∅) = ps.foldr Fv ∅ := rfl
      rw [List.foldr_cons, hF, ih l]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨q, hq, hex⟩
        exact ⟨q, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hq), hex⟩
      · rintro ⟨q, hq, hex⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq with h | hq'
        · subst h
          obtain ⟨c, s, hc, -⟩ := hex
          exact absurd hc (by simp)
        · exact ⟨q, hq', hex⟩
    | some c =>
      have hF : Fv (i, some c) (ps.foldr Fv ∅)
          = ps.foldr Fv ∅ ∪ (view c).image (fun s => (i : Int) :: s) := rfl
      rw [List.foldr_cons, hF, Set.mem_union, ih l]
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h)
        · obtain ⟨q, hq, hex⟩ := h
          exact ⟨q, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hq), hex⟩
        · obtain ⟨s, hs, hls⟩ := h
          exact ⟨(i, some c), by simp, c, s, rfl, hls.symm, hs⟩
      · rintro ⟨q, hq, hex⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq with h | hq'
        · subst h
          obtain ⟨c', s, hc', hl, hs⟩ := hex
          right
          have hcc : c' = c := by simpa using hc'.symm
          subst hcc
          exact ⟨s, hs, hl.symm⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨q, hq', hex⟩

lemma mem_view (t : Node) (l : List Int) :
    l ∈ view t ↔ (l = [] ∧ t.is_end = true) ∨
      ∃ (i : Nat) (c : Node) (s : List Int),
        t.children[i]? = some (some c) ∧ l = (i : Int) :: s ∧ s ∈ view c := by
  have hpart : ∀ (X : Set (List Int)),
      (l ∈ (if t.is_end then ({[]} : Set (List Int)) else ∅) ∪ X)
        ↔ ((l = [] ∧ t.is_end = true) ∨ l ∈ X) := by
    intro X
    by_cases hb : t.is_end = true
    · simp [hb]
    · simp [hb]
  rw [view_eq, hpart, mem_fold]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨p, hp, c, s, hc, hl, hs⟩)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · refine Or.inr ⟨p.1, c, s, ?_, hl, hs⟩
      rw [← mem_enumerate]
      have hpe : (p.1, some c) = p := by rw [← hc]
      rw [hpe]
      exact hp
  · rintro (h | ⟨i, c, s, hc, hl, hs⟩)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨(i, some c), (mem_enumerate _ i (some c)).mpr hc, c, s, rfl, hl, hs⟩

lemma mem_view_mk (b : Bool) (cs : List (Option Node)) (l : List Int) :
    l ∈ view (Node.mk b cs) ↔ (l = [] ∧ b = true) ∨
      ∃ (i : Nat) (c : Node) (s : List Int),
        cs[i]? = some (some c) ∧ l = (i : Int) :: s ∧ s ∈ view c := by
  rw [mem_view]
  try rfl

lemma mem_view_opt (t : Option Node) (l : List Int) :
    l ∈ view_opt t ↔ (l = [] ∧ isEndOf t = true) ∨
      ∃ (i : Nat) (c : Node) (s : List Int),
        (childrenOf t)[i]? = some (some c) ∧ l = (i : Int) :: s ∧ s ∈ view c := by
  cases t with
  | none =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact absurd h (by simp [view_opt])
    · rintro (⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨i, c, s, hc, -, -⟩)
      · simp [isEndOf] at h
      · have hcc : (childrenOf (none : Option Node)) = List.replicate 256 none := rfl
        rw [hcc] at hc
        have hcn := my_replicate_get?_none (none : Option Node) 256 i (some c) hc
        simp at hcn
  | some n =>
    have h1 : view_opt (some n) = view n := rfl
    rw [h1, mem_view n l]
    first
    | rfl
    | simp only [isEndOf, childrenOf]

/-! ### Facts about `childrenOf` -/

lemma childrenOf_length (t : Option Node) (ht : ∀ n, t = some n → well_formed n) :
    (childrenOf t).length = 256 := by
  cases t with
  | none =>
    have hcc : childrenOf (none : Option Node) = List.replicate 256 (none : Option Node) := rfl
    rw [hcc, List.length_replicate]
  | some n =>
    cases n with
    | mk b cs =>
      have h := ht (Node.mk b cs) rfl
      rw [well_formed_mk] at h
      have hcc : childrenOf (some (Node.mk b cs)) = cs := rfl
      rw [hcc]
      exact h.1

lemma childrenOf_wf_mem (t : Option Node) (ht : ∀ n, t = some n → well_formed n) :
    ∀ c ∈ childrenOf t, (match c with
      | some child => well_formed child ∧ (!is_empty_node child) = true
      | none => True) := by
  cases t with
  | none =>
    intro c hc
    have hcc : (childrenOf (none : Option Node)) = List.replicate 256 none := rfl
    rw [hcc] at hc
    have h0 : c = none := List.eq_of_mem_replicate hc
    rw [h0]
    exact trivial
  | some n =>
    cases n with
    | mk b cs =>
      intro c hc
      have h := ht (Node.mk b cs) rfl
      rw [well_formed_mk] at h
      have hcc : childrenOf (some (Node.mk b cs)) = cs := rfl
      rw [hcc] at hc
      exact h.2 c hc

lemma childrenOf_wf_get (t : Option Node) (ht : ∀ n, t = some n → well_formed n)
    (i : Nat) (c : Node) (h : (childrenOf t)[i]? = some (some c)) : well_formed c := by
  have h1 := childrenOf_wf_mem t ht (some c) (my_mem_of_get? _ _ _ h)
  exact h1.1

/-! ### Main specification of `insertAux` -/

lemma insertAux_spec : ∀ (key : List Int) (t : Option Node),
    is_valid_key key →
    (∀ n, t = some n → well_formed n) →
    well_formed (insertAux t key) ∧ is_empty_node (insertAux t key) = false ∧
      view (insertAux t key) = view_opt t ∪ {key} := by
  intro key
  induction key with
  | nil =>
    intro t hkey ht
    rw [insertAux_nil]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [well_formed_mk]
      exact ⟨childrenOf_length t ht, childrenOf_wf_mem t ht⟩
    · simp [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.children]
    · apply Set.ext
      intro l
      rw [mem_view_mk, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff, mem_view_opt t l]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨hl, -⟩ | ⟨i, c, s, hc, hl, hs⟩)
        · exact Or.inr hl
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, c, s, hc, hl, hs⟩)
      · rintro ((⟨hl, hb⟩ | ⟨i, c, s, hc, hl, hs⟩) | hl)
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hl, rfl⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨i, c, s, hc, hl, hs⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hl, rfl⟩
  | cons k rest ih =>
    intro t hkey ht
    obtain ⟨hk0, hk256⟩ := hkey k (by simp)
    have hrest : is_valid_key rest := by
      intro x hx
      exact hkey x (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hx))
    have hlen : (childrenOf t).length = 256 := childrenOf_length t ht
    have hidxlt : k.toNat < 256 := by omega
    have hcast : ((k.toNat : Nat) : Int) = k := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hk0
    have hidxlen : k.toNat < (childrenOf t).length := by rw [hlen]; exact hidxlt
    have hocget : (childrenOf t)[k.toNat]? = some (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) :=
      my_childAt_get? _ _ hidxlen
    have hocwf : ∀ n, childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat = some n → well_formed n := by
      intro n hn
      exact childrenOf_wf_get t ht k.toNat n (by rw [hocget, hn])
    obtain ⟨hwf1, hne1, hview1⟩ := ih (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) hrest hocwf
    have hsetself : ((childrenOf t).set k.toNat
        (some (insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest)))[k.toNat]?
        = some (some (insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest)) :=
      my_set_get?_self _ _ _ hidxlen
    rw [insertAux_cons]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [well_formed_mk]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.length_set]; exact hlen
      · intro c hc
        rcases my_mem_set_cases _ _ _ _ hc with h | hc'
        · rw [h]
          exact ⟨hwf1, by simp [hne1]⟩
        · exact childrenOf_wf_mem t ht c hc'
    · have hmem : (some (insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest)) ∈
          ((childrenOf t).set k.toNat
            (some (insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest))) :=
        my_mem_of_get? _ _ _ hsetself
      have hnone : ¬ (((childrenOf t).set k.toNat
          (some (insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest))).all Option.isNone = true) := by
        intro hall
        have hx := List.all_eq_true.mp hall _ hmem
        simp at hx
      simp [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.children, hnone]
    · apply Set.ext
      intro l
      rw [mem_view_mk, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff, mem_view_opt t l]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨hl, hb⟩ | ⟨i, c, s, hc, hl, hs⟩)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨hl, hb⟩)
        · by_cases hi : i = k.toNat
          · have h2 : ((childrenOf t).set k.toNat
                (some (insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest)))[i]?
                = some (some (insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest)) := by
              rw [hi]; exact hsetself
            rw [h2] at hc
            have hcc : c = insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest :=
              (Option.some_inj.mp (Option.some_inj.mp hc)).symm
            rw [hcc, hview1] at hs
            rcases hs with hs1 | hs1
            · cases hoc : childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat with
              | none =>
                rw [hoc] at hs1
                simp [view_opt] at hs1
              | some c' =>
                refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, c', s, ?_, hl, ?_⟩)
                · rw [hi, hocget, hoc]
                · rw [hoc] at hs1
                  exact hs1
            · have hs2 : s = rest := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hs1
              right
              rw [hl, hs2, hi, hcast]
          · refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, c, s, ?_, hl, hs⟩)
            rw [← my_set_get?_ne (childrenOf t) k.toNat i
              (some (insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest)) hi]
            exact hc
      · rintro ((⟨hl, hb⟩ | ⟨i, c, s, hc, hl, hs⟩) | hl)
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hl, hb⟩
        · by_cases hi : i = k.toNat
          · have hoc : childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat = some c := by
              have h3 : (childrenOf t)[k.toNat]? = some (some c) := by rw [← hi]; exact hc
              rw [hocget] at h3
              exact Option.some_inj.mp h3
            refine Or.inr ⟨i, insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest, s, ?_, hl, ?_⟩
            · rw [hi]; exact hsetself
            · rw [hview1]
              apply Set.mem_union_left
              rw [hoc]
              exact hs
          · refine Or.inr ⟨i, c, s, ?_, hl, hs⟩
            rw [my_set_get?_ne _ _ _ _ hi]
            exact hc
        · refine Or.inr ⟨k.toNat, insertAux (childAt (childrenOf t) k.toNat) rest, rest, hsetself,
            ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [hl, hcast]
          · rw [hview1]
            apply Set.mem_union_right
            rfl

-- Proof content
theorem insert_postcond_satisfied (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t key) :
    insert_postcond t key (insert t key h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h_precond
  have ht : ∀ n, t = some n → well_formed n := by
    cases t with
    | none => intro n hn; exact absurd hn (by simp)
    | some m =>
      intro n hn
      have hmn : m = n := Option.some_inj.mp hn
      subst hmn
      exact h1.1
  obtain ⟨hwf, hne, hview⟩ := insertAux_spec key t h2 ht
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
